name: cat-accueil
script: (() => { localStorage.removeItem('cybertools:favorites'); localStorage.removeItem('cybertools:recents'); const counts = Object.fromEntries([...document.querySelectorAll('.rail a[href^="/categories/"]')].map(a => [a.querySelector('.rail-item-label').textContent.trim(), parseInt(a.querySelector('.rail-count').textContent, 10)])); const indexed = parseInt(document.querySelector('.status-left').textContent, 10); const total = Object.values(counts).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); return (Object.keys(counts).length === 10 && total === indexed) || { indexed, total, counts }; })()

name: cat-recherche-accents
script: (() => { const first = document.querySelector('.results .tool-row'); const category = first?.querySelector('.tool-row-category')?.textContent.trim(); return category === 'network' || ('premier : ' + first?.querySelector('.tool-row-name')?.textContent.trim() + ' (' + category + ')'); })()

name: cat-recherche-anglais

name: cat-entree-premier
script: (async () => { const input = document.querySelector('.command-input'); input.value = 'jwt'; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1200)); const ok = location.pathname === '/tools/jwt-parser' && document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent.trim() === 'JWT parser'; return ok || { url: location.pathname, titre: document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent.trim() }; })()

name: cat-palette-ouverte
script: (async () => { document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'k', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const input = document.querySelector('.palette input'); return { ouverte: !!input, focus: document.activeElement === input, groupes: [...document.querySelectorAll('.group-title span:first-child')].map(g => g.textContent.trim()) }; })()

name: cat-palette-clavier
script: (async () => { const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'k', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true })); await wait(400); const input = document.querySelector('.palette input'); input.value = 'base64'; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await wait(250); const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.palette .item-label')].map(e => e.textContent.trim()); input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'ArrowDown', bubbles: true })); await wait(100); const choisi = document.querySelector('.item--active .item-label').textContent.trim(); input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); await wait(1200); return { résultats: items.slice(0, 3), choisi, url: location.pathname, fermée: !document.querySelector('.palette') }; })()

name: cat-palette-slash
script: (async () => { document.body.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '/', bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); return !!document.querySelector('.palette input'); })()

name: cat-favori
script: (async () => { const star = document.querySelector('#ct-topbar-actions .favorite'); star.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); return { pressé: star.getAttribute('aria-pressed'), stockage: localStorage.getItem('cybertools:favorites') }; })()

name: cat-recents-ancien-format

name: cat-recents-ouverture
script: (async () => { const link = [...document.querySelectorAll('.resume .tool-row-link')].find(a => a.textContent.includes('Hash text')); link.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1200)); history.back(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.resume .tool-row')].map(r => r.querySelector('.tool-row-name').textContent.trim() + '|' + (r.querySelector('.tool-row-meta')?.textContent.trim() ?? '')); const entry = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cybertools:recents')).find(e => e.id === 'hash-text'); return (rows[0] === 'Hash text|now' && entry.count === 2 && entry.at > 0) || { rows, entry }; })()

name: cat-plus-utilises-prepa
script: (() => { const now = Date.now(); localStorage.setItem('cybertools:recents', JSON.stringify([{ id: 'hash-text', at: now, count: 3 }, { id: 'jwt-parser', at: now - 1000, count: 7 }, { id: 'url-parser', at: now - 2000, count: 7 }])); return true; })()

name: cat-plus-utilises
script: (() => { const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.usage-item')].map(i => i.querySelector('.usage-name').textContent.trim() + ':' + i.querySelector('.usage-count').textContent.trim() + ':' + Math.round(parseFloat(i.querySelector('.usage-fill').style.width))); return items.join() === 'JWT parser:7:100,URL parser:7:100,Hash text:3:43' || items; })()

name: cat-categorie-filtre
script: (() => { const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.rows .tool-row-name')].map(e => e.textContent.trim()); const field = document.querySelector('.filter-input'); return (field.value === 'sha' && names.length > 0 && names.length < 176 && names.slice(0, 3).includes('Hash text')) || { valeur: field.value, nombre: names.length, premiers: names.slice(0, 5) }; })()
